Subject: The Rules of ZenMemes.com

1st Rule: You do not overthink the meme.
2nd Rule: You DO NOT overthink the meme.
3rd Rule: If someone says "breathe," logs off, or finds inner peace, the thread is over.
4th Rule: Only two ideas to a punchline.
5th Rule: One meme at a time, friends.
6th Rule: No clout, no cringe.
7th Rule: Memes will sit in silence as long as they have to.
8th Rule: If this is your first time at ZenMemes.com, you have to post.
